privacy.content:
# Privacy Policy

CheapestDomains, operated by TrueHost Kenya, is committed to protecting your privacy.

## 1. Introduction
This Privacy Policy explains how we collect, use, disclose, and safeguard your information when you use our domain registration and management services.

## 2. Information We Collect
When you register an account or domain, we collect contact information, account information, payment information, and domain registration data.

## 3. How We Use Your Information
We use collected information for service delivery, communication, and improvement & analytics.

## 4. Your Rights
You have the right to access, correct, or delete your personal data. Contact us at support@cheapestdomains.com.

## 5. Contact Us
For privacy concerns, contact us at support@cheapestdomains.com

terms.content:
# Terms of Service

By accessing and using CheapestDomains ("Service"), you agree to be bound by these Terms of Service ("Terms").

## 1. Agreement to Terms
If you disagree with any part of the terms, you may not access the Service.

## 2. Domain Registration Services
When you register a domain through our Service, you enter into a registration agreement with the respective domain registry.

## 3. Pricing and Payment
Domain registration and renewal fees are listed on our website. All fees are non-refundable except as required by law.

## 4. Acceptable Use
You may not use our Service for any illegal purposes or to violate any applicable laws.

## 5. Contact Us
For questions about these Terms, contact us at support@cheapestdomains.com
